user.title: Connect to poschodoch.sk
user.description: Paste the refresh token from your browser's local storage. Open https://www.poschodoch.sk, sign in, then in DevTools go to Application → Local Storage → www.poschodoch.sk and copy the value of the `id_refresh_token` key.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate poschodoch.sk
reauth_confirm.description: Your poschodoch.sk session has expired or was revoked. Repeat the same steps to get a fresh refresh token from your browser's local storage.

error.invalid_auth: That refresh token was rejected. Make sure you copied it correctly and that you're still signed in on poschodoch.sk.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach poschodoch.sk. Check your connection and try again.
